SELECT
              g.total_agents,
              g.total_makers,
              g.created_last_30d,
              c.prepaid_credits,
              c.prepaid_cost_eur,
              e.payg_credits,
              e.payg_cost_eur
            FROM (
              SELECT
                MEASURE(valid_agent_count) AS total_agents,
                MEASURE(maker_count) AS total_makers,
                MEASURE(created_last_30d) AS created_last_30d
              FROM automation_d.silver.metric_agent_governance_v2
            ) g
            CROSS JOIN (
              SELECT
                MEASURE(total_consumption_credits) AS prepaid_credits,
                ROUND(MEASURE(total_consumption_cost_eur), 2) AS prepaid_cost_eur
              FROM automation_d.silver.metric_credit_consumption_v2
            ) c
            CROSS JOIN (
              SELECT
                MEASURE(pay_as_you_go_credits) AS payg_credits,
                ROUND(MEASURE(pay_as_you_go_credits) * (SELECT MAX(credit_to_eur) FROM automation_d.silver.ref_credit_rate), 2) AS payg_cost_eur
              FROM automation_d.silver.metric_environment_consumption_v2
            ) e

SELECT b.agent_category,
                   ROUND(COALESCE(c.credits, 0), 1) AS credits,
                   ROUND(COALESCE(c.cost_eur, 0), 2) AS cost_eur
            FROM (
              SELECT 'Copilot Studio' AS agent_category, 1 AS sort_order
              UNION ALL SELECT 'Agent Builder', 2
              UNION ALL SELECT 'Platform Tool', 3
            ) b
            LEFT JOIN (
              SELECT agent_category,
                     MEASURE(total_consumption_credits) AS credits,
                     MEASURE(total_consumption_cost_eur) AS cost_eur
              FROM automation_d.silver.metric_credit_consumption_v2
              GROUP BY agent_category
            ) c ON b.agent_category = c.agent_category
            ORDER BY b.sort_order

SELECT agent_name,
                   agent_category,
                   ROUND(MEASURE(total_consumption_credits), 1) AS credits,
                   ROUND(MEASURE(total_consumption_cost_eur), 2) AS cost_eur
            FROM automation_d.silver.metric_credit_consumption_v2
            WHERE agent_category <> 'Platform Tool'
            GROUP BY agent_name, agent_category
            ORDER BY credits DESC
            LIMIT 10

SELECT environment_region, COUNT(DISTINCT agent_key) AS agent_count

SELECT environment_type, COUNT(DISTINCT agent_key) AS agent_count
            FROM automation_d.silver.vw_agent_governance
            WHERE is_valid_agent AND environment_type IS NOT NULL
            GROUP BY environment_type

SELECT CASE WHEN is_managed THEN 'Managed' ELSE 'Unmanaged' END AS env_mgmt,
                   COUNT(DISTINCT agent_key) AS agent_count
            FROM automation_d.silver.vw_agent_governance

SELECT model, COUNT(DISTINCT agent_key) AS agent_count
            FROM automation_d.silver.vw_agent_governance
            WHERE is_valid_agent

SELECT orchestration, COUNT(DISTINCT agent_key) AS agent_count
            FROM automation_d.silver.vw_agent_governance
            WHERE is_valid_agent

SELECT 'Used (credit-linked)' AS usage_category,
                   MEASURE(used_agent_count) AS agent_count
            FROM automation_d.silver.metric_agent_governance_v2
            UNION ALL
            SELECT 'Dormant (no measurable credit)', MEASURE(dormant_agent_count)
            FROM automation_d.silver.metric_agent_governance_v2

SELECT 'Billed (prepaid pool)' AS category,
                   MEASURE(billed_credits) AS credits,
                   ROUND(MEASURE(billed_credits) * (SELECT MAX(credit_to_eur) FROM automation_d.silver.ref_credit_rate), 2) AS cost_eur
            FROM automation_d.silver.metric_agent_feature_credit_v2
            UNION ALL
            SELECT 'Absorbed (license/included)',
                   ROUND(MEASURE(non_billed_credits), 1),
                   ROUND(MEASURE(non_billed_credits) * (SELECT MAX(credit_to_eur) FROM automation_d.silver.ref_credit_rate), 2)
            FROM automation_d.silver.metric_agent_feature_credit_v2

SELECT usage_date_eu AS date_eu,
                   usage_date AS date,
                   SUM(prepaid_consumed_quantity) AS daily_credits,
                   ROUND(SUM(prepaid_consumed_quantity) * (SELECT MAX(credit_to_eur) FROM automation_d.silver.ref_credit_rate), 2) AS daily_cost_eur
            FROM automation_d.silver.fact_environment_credit
            GROUP BY usage_date_eu, usage_date
            ORDER BY usage_date

SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER(m365_copilot_licensed) IN ('true', 'yes', '1') THEN 'M365 Copilot licensed' ELSE 'Not licensed' END AS license_status,
                   COUNT(DISTINCT user_email) AS users,
                   ROUND(MEASURE(total_consumption_credits), 1) AS credits,
                   ROUND(MEASURE(total_consumption_cost_eur), 2) AS cost_eur
            FROM automation_d.silver.metric_credit_consumption_v2
            GROUP BY m365_copilot_licensed

SELECT
              ROUND(MEASURE(total_consumption_credits), 1) AS total_credits,
              ROUND(MEASURE(total_consumption_cost_eur), 2) AS total_cost_eur
            FROM automation_d.silver.metric_credit_consumption_v2

SELECT product,
                   ROUND(MEASURE(total_credits), 1) AS credits,
                   ROUND(MEASURE(total_cost_eur), 2) AS cost_eur
            FROM automation_d.silver.metric_agent_feature_credit_v2
            GROUP BY product
            ORDER BY credits DESC

SELECT
              ROUND(SUM(prepaid_consumed_quantity) / COUNT(DISTINCT usage_date), 1) AS avg_daily_credits,
              ROUND(SUM(prepaid_consumed_quantity) / COUNT(DISTINCT usage_date) * 30, 0) AS projected_monthly_credits,
              ROUND(SUM(prepaid_consumed_quantity) / COUNT(DISTINCT usage_date) * 30 * (SELECT MAX(credit_to_eur) FROM automation_d.silver.ref_credit_rate), 2) AS projected_monthly_eur
            FROM automation_d.silver.fact_environment_credit

SELECT
              MEASURE(valid_agent_count) AS valid_agents,
              MEASURE(at_risk_agent_count) AS at_risk_agents,
              ROUND(100.0 * MEASURE(at_risk_agent_count) / MEASURE(total_agent_count), 1) AS risk_rate_pct,
              ROUND(100.0 * MEASURE(dormant_agent_count) / MEASURE(valid_agent_count), 1) AS dormant_rate_pct
            FROM automation_d.silver.metric_agent_governance_v2

SELECT 'Created (valid)' AS stage, MEASURE(valid_agent_count) AS agent_count
            FROM automation_d.silver.metric_agent_governance_v2
            UNION ALL
            SELECT 'Published', MEASURE(published_agent_count)
            FROM automation_d.silver.metric_agent_governance_v2
            UNION ALL
            SELECT 'Used (credit-linked)', MEASURE(used_agent_count)
            FROM automation_d.silver.metric_agent_governance_v2

SELECT created_by, COUNT(DISTINCT agent_key) AS at_risk_count
            FROM automation_d.silver.vw_agent_governance
            WHERE is_valid_agent
              AND (is_no_auth OR NOT is_managed)
            GROUP BY created_by
            ORDER BY at_risk_count DESC
            LIMIT 15

SELECT agent_name, platform, created_by, environment_name, status,
                   authentication, usage_status, created_on_date, created_on_eu,
                   concat_ws(', ',
                     CASE WHEN is_no_auth THEN 'No Auth' END,
                     CASE WHEN NOT is_valid_agent THEN 'No Owner' END,
                     CASE WHEN is_valid_agent AND NOT is_managed THEN 'Unmanaged Env' END,
                     CASE WHEN is_valid_agent AND coalesce(status, '-') <> 'Available' THEN 'Draft' END) AS risk_reasons,
                   greatest(
                     CASE WHEN is_no_auth THEN 3 ELSE 0 END,
                     CASE WHEN NOT is_valid_agent THEN 2 ELSE 0 END,
                     CASE WHEN is_valid_agent AND NOT is_managed THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severity
            FROM automation_d.silver.vw_agent_governance
            WHERE is_no_auth
               OR (NOT is_valid_agent)
               OR (is_valid_agent AND NOT is_managed)
            ORDER BY severity DESC, agent_name

SELECT environment_name, 'No Authentication' AS risk_category,
                   COUNT(DISTINCT agent_key) AS agent_count
            FROM automation_d.silver.vw_agent_governance
            WHERE is_no_auth AND environment_name IS NOT NULL

            UNION ALL
            SELECT environment_name, 'Orphaned / No Owner', COUNT(DISTINCT agent_key)
            FROM automation_d.silver.vw_agent_governance
            WHERE NOT is_valid_agent AND environment_name IS NOT NULL
            GROUP BY environment_name

            SELECT environment_name, 'Unmanaged Environment', COUNT(DISTINCT agent_key)
            FROM automation_d.silver.vw_agent_governance
            WHERE is_valid_agent AND NOT is_managed AND environment_name IS NOT NULL
            GROUP BY environment_name

queryLines:
WITH ref AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', MAX(usage_date)) AS current_month
  FROM
    automation_d.silver.bot_usage
),
agent_month AS (
  SELECT
    bot_name,
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', usage_date) AS month,
    SUM(conversations) AS convs
  FROM
    automation_d.silver.bot_usage
  GROUP BY
    bot_name,
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', usage_date)
)
SELECT
  cur.bot_name,
  prev.convs AS prior_month,
  COALESCE(cur2.convs, 0) AS last_full_month,
  ROUND((COALESCE(cur2.convs, 0) - prev.convs) * 100.0 / prev.convs, 1) AS change_pct
FROM
  (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      bot_name
    FROM
      agent_month
  ) cur
    CROSS JOIN ref r
    JOIN agent_month prev
      ON prev.bot_name = cur.bot_name
      AND prev.month = ADD_MONTHS(r.current_month, -2)
    LEFT JOIN agent_month cur2
      ON cur2.bot_name = cur.bot_name
      AND cur2.month = ADD_MONTHS(r.current_month, -1)
WHERE
  prev.convs >= 10
  AND COALESCE(cur2.convs, 0) < prev.convs * 0.5
ORDER BY
  change_pct

datasets.name: ds_consumption_abandoned
queryLines:
WITH ref AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(usage_date) AS max_dt
  FROM
    automation_d.silver.bot_usage
)
SELECT
  b.bot_name,
  SUM(b.conversations) AS lifetime_conversations,
  COUNT(DISTINCT b.usage_date) AS lifetime_active_days,
  MAX(b.usage_date) AS last_used,
  DATEDIFF(r.max_dt, MAX(b.usage_date)) AS days_since_last_use
FROM
  automation_d.silver.bot_usage b CROSS JOIN ref r
GROUP BY
  b.bot_name,
  r.max_dt
HAVING
  SUM(b.conversations) >= 20
  AND MAX(b.usage_date) < DATE_SUB(r.max_dt, 60)
ORDER BY
  lifetime_conversations DESC

datasets.name: ds_consumption_mom
queryLines:
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', usage_date) AS month,
    SUM(conversations) AS convs
  FROM
    automation_d.silver.bot_usage
  GROUP BY
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', usage_date)
),
ref AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', MAX(usage_date)) AS current_month
  FROM
    automation_d.silver.bot_usage
)
SELECT
  prev.convs AS prior_month_conversations,
  cur.convs AS last_full_month_conversations,
  ROUND((cur.convs - prev.convs) * 100.0 / prev.convs, 1) AS mom_growth_pct
FROM
  ref r
    JOIN monthly cur
      ON cur.month = ADD_MONTHS(r.current_month, -1)
    JOIN monthly prev
      ON prev.month = ADD_MONTHS(r.current_month, -2)

datasets.name: ds_consumption_agent_detail
datasets.displayName: Bot Usage Agent Detail with Status
queryLines:
WITH ref AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(usage_date) AS max_dt
  FROM
    automation_d.silver.bot_usage
),
bot_status AS (
  SELECT
    b.bot_name,
    CASE
      WHEN MAX(b.usage_date) >= DATE_SUB(r.max_dt, 30) THEN 'Active (last 30 days)'
      WHEN MAX(b.usage_date) >= DATE_SUB(r.max_dt, 60) THEN 'Idle (31-60 days)'
      ELSE 'Dormant (60+ days)'
    END AS usage_status,
    MIN(b.usage_date) AS first_used,
    MAX(b.usage_date) AS last_used,
    DATEDIFF(r.max_dt, MAX(b.usage_date)) AS days_since_last_use,
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.usage_date) AS active_days,
    ROUND(AVG(b.conversations), 2) AS avg_conversations_per_bot_day
  FROM
    automation_d.silver.bot_usage b CROSS JOIN ref r
  GROUP BY
    b.bot_name,
    r.max_dt
)
SELECT
  b.bot_name,
  b.environment,
  CASE
    WHEN b.environment LIKE '%PROD%' THEN 'Production'
    WHEN LOWER(b.environment) LIKE '%default%' THEN 'Default environment'
    ELSE 'Dev / Test / Other'
  END AS environment_type,
  DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', b.usage_date) AS usage_month,
  DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', b.usage_date) AS usage_quarter,
  CONCAT(
    YEAR(DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', b.usage_date)),
    ' Q',
    QUARTER(DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', b.usage_date))
  ) AS quarter_label,
  SUM(b.conversations) AS conversations,
  s.usage_status,
  s.first_used,
  s.last_used,
  s.days_since_last_use,
  s.active_days,
  s.avg_conversations_per_bot_day
FROM
  automation_d.silver.bot_usage b
    JOIN bot_status s
      ON s.bot_name = b.bot_name
GROUP BY
  b.bot_name,
  b.environment,
  DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', b.usage_date),
  DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', b.usage_date),
  s.usage_status,
  s.first_used,
  s.last_used,
  s.days_since_last_use,
  s.active_days,
  s.avg_conversations_per_bot_day

Every Copilot Studio agent can be attached to **knowledge bases** (SharePoint sites, files, public sites, Dataverse and federated sources).
